source.text: Sorry you don't understand that is a knock at america and our issues with gun control. No one is minimizing the Ottawa shooting.

selection_rule: Strict explicit stance only. Support means the comment accepts the source tweet's framing that the post is a criticism of America's gun control/gun violence problem, or argues for gun control. Oppose means the comment rejects the gun-control framing, argues gun control does not work, or argues more lawful guns/good guys with guns are needed.
note: Selected 30 explicit comments with balanced stances. Ambiguous, social-only, link-only, and purely meta comments were excluded.
